notes.agents: Read AGENTS.md then docs/ai-onboarding.md before using the kit. Validate this file with `python -m tools config-check`.
notes.protected_path_markers: Path segments that are read-only wherever they appear, including outside the repo. Use this when the VB6 originals live on a share instead of inside the repo; protected_source_dirs may then be empty.
notes.protected: Directories listed in protected_source_dirs are read-only. Hooks deny Write/StrReplace/Delete into them. Exception: `python -m tools fixture` (tools/make_fixture.py) may regenerate source/mini_vbp/. Rename via this list if your immutable tree is not called source/.
notes.default_extract: Optional extract folder name used when --extract is omitted and several extracts exist. Consumers investigating one project among many set it here instead of hardcoding the name in tools.
notes.scan: scan_roots / scan_skip_dirs drive scan-chars. Protected dirs and path markers are skipped automatically, so they need not be repeated here.
notes.geometry_hints: Optional map of FormName → {left,top,width,height} twips used when evaluating parent-relative runtime expressions.
notes.mdi_defaults: Consumer-only. Emitted as mdiDefaults in runtime-layout.json for reimplementation; empty means the key is omitted. Keep app numbers in the consumer config.
notes.mdi_chrome: Consumer-only. shell_forms = MDI shell VB_Name(s); control_names = chrome controls (e.g. Picture1, FG1, fg2). Kit default empty — do not hardcode app shell names in tools. Common consumer example: shell_forms ["MDIForm1"], control_names ["Picture1", "FG1", "fg2"].
notes.deep_read_name_map: Optional map of VB_Name → output key for frm_deep_read.py / frm_deep_read_all.py (e.g. {"MDIForm1": "mdi"}). Empty = lowercase VB_Name (not file stem).
notes.layout_sub_scores: Optional map of lowercase Sub name → int score for runtime_layout open-path preference. Kit default is form_load/mdiform_load only. Put app-specific openers (e.g. stet_click) in the consumer config — do not upstream them into the kit.
notes.picture1_height_by_sub: Optional map of lowercase Sub (or sub@file_vb) → Form VB_Name for Picture1.Height context when near_show is empty. Consumer-only; keep empty in the kit.
notes.verify_report_allow_files: Optional list of basename tokens allowed by verify_report_names.py beyond inventory (other VBP / shared modules). Consumer-only.
notes.consumer: When adopting this kit, set protected_source_dirs to your immutable VB6 tree name(s). Use requires LICENSE permission.
